# pondlog

> Place-aware nature data for developers.

## What is pondlog

Open-source nature data aggregation: 8 data sources, 6 MCP servers, CLI, and npm packages.

Garden planning (1,000-crop calendar, companion graph, USDA zones, climate types) lives in CropGraph, a separate product. See https://cropgraph.com.

## Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/andrewschristison/pondlog
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/org/pondlog
- CropGraph: https://cropgraph.com
- MCP Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io

## MCP Servers

npx @pondlog/mcp-inaturalist
npx @pondlog/mcp-ebird
npx @pondlog/mcp-npn
npx @pondlog/mcp-usgs
npx @pondlog/mcp-mushroomobserver
npx @pondlog/mcp-pondlog

## Garden planning

npx @cropgraph/mcp
